# API Fundamentals - Nice to Know 
### **DISCLAIMER** This readme was generated by AI based on the 2 ps1 files **DISCLAIMER**

## Description
This session provides a practical introduction to working with APIs using PowerShell. We'll explore HTTP methods, authentication techniques, and common patterns for API interaction. Whether you're new to APIs or looking to enhance your existing knowledge, this session will equip you with the fundamentals needed to effectively integrate APIs into your automation workflows.

## What You'll Learn
- Understanding HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) and when to use each
- Implementing different authentication methods (Basic, API Key, OAuth/Bearer Tokens)
- Handling pagination, limits, and offsets in API responses
- Making effective API calls with PowerShell's Invoke-RestMethod
- Working with JSON data in API requests and responses

## Session Files
1. **`1. The diffrent methods.ps1`** - Examples of each HTTP method with the JSONPlaceholder API
2. **`2. Some getting started material.ps1`** - Authentication, pagination, and parameter handling examples

## Key Takeaways
- ✅ Choose the right HTTP method for the operation you need to perform
- ✅ Implement proper authentication based on API requirements
- ✅ Handle large datasets through pagination, limits, and offsets
- ✅ Process API responses effectively in PowerShell
- ✅ Structure API requests according to best practices
